blocks.text: Possible origin. A company, state, platform, or organizer recognizes commercial or strategic value in cyber-pets, archives, Paths, or player data.
Function. The Broker personalizes the New Harvest threat: incentives turn care, identity, and relationship into property, metrics, and scalable access.
Risk. Exposure, safeguards, refusal, or cyber-pet law may defeat the Broker; partial reform could leave the extraction system intact.
